title: The symmetric arm of the codeword/layer de-confounding: basket at button's layer (L20)
frozen_before_reading: any basket-at-L20 arm. No basket L20 rescue arm has ever been run.
question: The sprint's headline is a CODEWORD dissociation: basket's rank-1 installation axis beats its 46-control family on both splits (D12) while button's does not (4 of 11 at L20, 8 of 11 at L18). Basket ran only at L18 and button only at L20, so CODEWORD and LAYER were perfectly confounded. S-104 broke the confound on the button side: button fails at L18 too. This is the other half -- does basket still show the effect at BUTTON's layer?
why_this_is_not_a_second_bite: The claim under test is D12's, and the test can only weaken it. A pass adds nothing to D12's significance (the family here is 10 controls, floor 0.0909, which cannot certify at 0.05); a failure forces the framing to change. The asymmetry is deliberate.
what_is_actually_at_stake: Neither outcome can revive 'it is only the layer' -- button-at-L18's failure (S-104) already excluded that. What is at stake is CODEWORD-ONLY versus a CODEWORD x LAYER INTERACTION. If basket passes at L20, the effect follows the codeword across both layers and 'codeword dissociation' is fully de-confounded. If basket fails at L20, then the pass requires basket AND L18 together, and the phrase 'codeword dissociation' must be qualified to a codeword x layer interaction.

basis_verified.note: The check S-103 used -- 'cand_rank1 sha16 differs from the other layer's file, therefore --force-layer was honoured' -- is UNSOUND and is NOT relied on here. Demonstrated in S-106: configs/dcs_csi_axis_basket_behavioral.json and ..._shuf24.json are the SAME axis at the SAME layer 18, their recorded bases.cand_rank1.sha16 DIFFER (0c397a778db933ba vs fad8b030ae93976e), and yet the stored float32 tensors are BITWISE IDENTICAL (max abs diff 0.000e+00, cosine exactly 1.000000000000). A differing sha16 therefore carries essentially no information. Only an IDENTICAL sha16 would have been conclusive, in the opposite direction.

SOUND_force_layer_evidence.method: compare the stored tensors per basis family against the L18 file, which separates the layer-dependent bases from the layer-independent ones
SOUND_force_layer_evidence.bitwise_identical_to_L18: EXACTLY the 22 ctrl_random bases, and nothing else -- correct, since those are pure Gaussian draws from the same seed and dimension and do not depend on the layer
SOUND_force_layer_evidence.moved_vs_L18: all 31 data-dependent bases: cand_rank1, cand_pls1-5, ctrl_orth, ctrl_shuffled0-23
SOUND_force_layer_evidence.why_this_is_conclusive: a layer override that had been silently ignored would have left the data-dependent bases bitwise identical too, and the cosine at 1.0. 22 identical / 31 moved is the exact partition the override predicts.

artifact_race_resolved.what_happened: two jobs (905947 mine, 905948 a subagent's) independently built this same output path 17 seconds apart -- a self-inflicted race, recorded in S-106
artifact_race_resolved.resolution: rebuilt once cleanly to configs/dcs_csi_axis_basket_L20_rebuild.pt with no competing job; the raced file is BITWISE IDENTICAL to the clean rebuild on all 53 of 53 bases, .pt key set equals .json key set in both, and every load-bearing json scalar agrees. The race was benign and the file is not torn -- verified, not assumed.

basis_verified.fit_domains: 67, all TRAIN, zero VALIDATION and zero TEST (re-resolved through the split manifest)

statistical_unit: DOMAIN. Rows estimate within-domain means only and never inflate n.
primary_statistic: the rank of KO_AXIS - KO among the 10 controls' own (control - KO) values
floor_is_declared_in_advance: 1/11 = 0.0909 CANNOT certify at 0.05. This arm can show WHERE basket-at-L20 sits; it cannot on its own certify a pass.

required_gates.manipulation: KO - BASE clearly negative on substantially all domains
required_gates.instrument_capable: KO_FULL - KO clearly positive. IF NOT, this arm is CANNOT ANSWER (dead instrument at this layer), NOT a negative for the axis.

void_conditions: compared arms not on one GPU architecture
rescue did not fire on every persisted row of a rescue arm
rescued arms disagree on the layer, or any arm's rows record a layer other than 20
arms used different banks or exclusion files
row loss beyond the norm-match degeneracy guard, or a DONE.json ledger disagreeing with rows on disk

decision_rule.rank_1_of_11: CONSISTENT WITH CODEWORD-ONLY, but INCONCLUSIVE at this floor. Extend the family to 46 to match D12 before any statement is made. Exactly the rule S-103 fixed for button-at-L18.
decision_rule.rank_2_or_3_of_11: AMBIGUOUS. Extend to 46 before saying anything either way.
decision_rule.rank_4_or_worse_of_11: basket-at-L20 DOES NOT show the effect at this resolution. The honest framing becomes a CODEWORD x LAYER INTERACTION, prohibition 21's wording must be changed, and D13's limit note is discharged in the direction that weakens us.

prediction_fixed_before_data: I expect rank 1 of 11, i.e. codeword-only. I record that expectation so that a FAILURE cannot later be described as anything other than a result that overturns the framing I already held, and so that a pass is not mistaken for a surprise.
must_not_be_said_if_positive: the dissociation is fully de-confounded (10 controls cannot certify; that needs the 46-control extension)
basket's axis is causal (prohibition 19 stands: the effect is 3.9% of the knockout)
this replicates D12 (it is the same claim at a different layer, on TRAIN, not a replication)
must_not_be_said_if_null: the layer explains the dissociation (button-at-L18 already excluded that)
D12 is withdrawn (D12 is a 46-control result on both splits at L18; this is 10 controls on TRAIN at L20)
basket's axis is not causal at L18
